top_signals.title: Trucking group’s lawsuit threatens to upend federal carrier registration system
top_signals.summary:
The Small Business in Transportation Coalition is challenging the legality of the federal Uniform Crime Reporting system as its operators warn that a successful lawsuit could disrupt registration fees and state motor carrier safety funding.
